system.description: Characters whose capabilities are part of what they are rather than something learned. They unleash these qualities through powerful transformations, quickly shifting form to fill whatever role is needed.
system.benefit: Gain access to the Gestalt Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Gestalt, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Gestalt Expertise and two additional Gestalt Action Cards.

origin.name: Efficient Transformation
origin.text: Reduce the Stamina cost of transformation upkeep by 1, to a minimum of 1.
